CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Netball.
   B. Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Netball.
